about.title: About
about.subtitle: Pure is an AI image workbench — eight capabilities, from the first draft to the final polish, behind one interface.
about.valuesSubtitle: Three decisions that shaped what this product looks like.

workbench.title: One workbench
workbench.desc: Text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, outpainting, background removal, upscaling, object removal and style transfer — without shuffling files between separate tools.

capability.title: Capabilities out in the open
capability.desc: Whatever a model cannot do is greyed out in the interface. Pick an unsupported combination and you are stopped before submitting, with the reason given.

bilingual.title: Chinese is not an afterthought
bilingual.desc: Chinese and English are both first-class. Style presets and the prompt library ship with Chinese, rather than English with a translation layer bolted on.

about.techDesc: Models arrive through a single adapter layer: one request contract plus a set of capability flags. Adding a vendor means writing one file — no changes to the frontend or the job pipeline. Greying out modes, choosing which controls to show and settling credits are all driven by what a model declares about itself.
